text: Basic Electronics Company Ltd — the company behind the Al-Asasyah (الأساسية) brand — describes itself as a 100% Saudi company.

source.name: Al-Asasyah / Basic Electronics Company – About us (company website)
source.quote: BASIC ELECTRONICS COMPANY LTD. is 100% a Saudi company.
source.note: The Arabic text on the same page reads 'شركة الأساسية للإلكترونيات المحدودة هي شركة سعودية بنسبة 100٪' (Basic Electronics Company Ltd is a 100% Saudi company). The page is undated; the date is the day it was opened. The source does not name the company's shareholders.
